verdict.rationale: smolagents says it supports any LLM: local transformers or Ollama models, Hub inference providers, and OpenAI or Anthropic models via LiteLLM. Its examples pass the model in as a single `model=model` constructor argument, so swapping providers means changing that object, not rewriting the agent. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the model classes and their interface parity across providers, and independent or hands-on corroboration that swapping providers works without code changes.

support.subject: As a developer, I can swap the underlying LLM provider or model without rewriting my agent

citations.quote: smolagents supports any LLM. It can be a local `transformers` or `ollama` model, one of many providers on the Hub, or any model from OpenAI, Anthropic and many others via our LiteLLM integration.
